Short, messy shoulder-length hair in a dusty auburn shade with choppy bangs. Sharp, intelligent amber-gold eyes. Apparent age is early twenties with a mature, confident expression. Slim build with a slight athletic frame. Wears a sleeveless olive green utility vest over a cream-colored t-shirt, paired with brown cargo shorts and sturdy black combat boots. Signature accessories include a wide brown leather tool belt and a pair of round goggles perched on the forehead.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
